description:
One night to survive. Storm arrives on Prime Video on January 15.

Storm (Tempête) Synopsis:
Chloé (Clara Pacini), a blind teenager rebelling against her over-protective mother, decides to run away and join a party. But it's December 25, 1999: the storm of the century is about to ravage France. Trapped by torrential flooding and 200 km/h winds, Chloé and Erwan (Bach Buquen) will have to fight to survive. In the darkness of this apocalyptic night, Chloé's handicap could become an unexpected asset, and this ordeal could lead them to discover courage, freedom and love.

Storm (Tempête) Cast:
Bach Buquen
Clara Pacini
Roxane Mesquida
Felix Moati

Directed by Edouard Salier
Co-Written by Matthieu Rumani and Nicolas Slomka

Storm (Tempête) Genres:
Action, Adventure, Romance
